heroHeadline: Drone Strikes Shut Key Pipeline as Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Escalate
heroSubtitle: A Sept 10 drone attack launched from Iraq forced Saudi Arabia to shut its East-West pipeline, the kingdom's main bypass for the Iran-closed Strait of Hormuz, before Aramco restored full 7 million bpd capacity by Sept 15. Separately, a reignited Yemen war brought a Sept 8 Houthi missile and drone barrage on Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran that wounded 73 people, followed by a Sept 14 strike claiming 'significant losses' at King Khalid Air Base. Saudi Arabia's coalition responded on Sept 15 with 54 airstrikes on Houthi positions in Yemen, which Houthi officials said killed three people, as Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met US CENTCOM commander Admiral Brad Cooper in Jeddah to review the deteriorating security picture.
